smallshipsheraldry.help.title: Heraldry editor help
smallshipsheraldry.help.print: Right-click the paper slot to add paper, press Print, then left-click the output slot to collect the pattern.
smallshipsheraldry.help.ship: Sneak and use the pattern on a matching ship. Sneak and use shears to remove an installed pattern.
smallshipsheraldry.help.paint: LMB paints. Shift+LMB rotates. RMB pans. The wheel zooms.
smallshipsheraldry.help.elements: MMB selects an element. H hides it; U shows all elements.
smallshipsheraldry.help.tools: B/E/I/F select brush, eraser, picker and face fill. F1 opens help.
smallshipsheraldry.help.colors: LMB selects a saved colour; RMB or Shift+LMB overwrites it.
smallshipsheraldry.help.opacity: The bar below the picker controls opacity. Erasing makes pixels empty.
smallshipsheraldry.help.history: 1–5 or [ ] change sail stage. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo.
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.author: Author: %s
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.result_slot: Left-click to collect the printed pattern
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.duplicate: Surround with 8 paper in a crafting table to duplicate
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.install: Sneak + use on a matching ship to install
smallshipsheraldry.tooltip.remove: Sneak + use shears on the ship to remove
smallshipsheraldry.message.invalid_patte: This heraldry pattern is damaged or invalid
smallshipsheraldry.message.pattern_too_c: The pattern is too detailed to save. Undo or erase some isolated pixels.
